chunks: 3751 - The Commander of the Faithful عليه السلام said:

A Bedouin from Banū ʿĀmir came to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله and asked him about the worst places of the earth and the best places of the earth. So the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said to him: “The worst places of the earth are the markets, and they are the میدان of Iblis. He goes forth with his banner, sets down his throne, and spreads his offspring. Among them is one who gives short measure in a qafīz, one who is careless in a scale, one who steals in measuring length, or one who lies regarding merchandise. Then he says: ‘Attach yourselves to a man whose father has died while your father is alive.’ So he does not cease, despite that, to be the first to enter and the last to leave.”
Then he عليه السلام said: “And the best places are the mosques, and the most beloved of them to Allah, Mighty and Exalted, are those who enter them first and leave them last.”

key_terms.أَوَّلُهُمْ دُخُولًا وَ آخِرُهُمْ خُرُوج: those who enter first and leave last, indicating strong attachment to the mosque
key_terms.الْأَسْوَاقُ: the markets, a place of buying and selling mentioned as spiritually dangerous
key_terms.الْمَسَاجِدُ: the mosques, described as the best places on earth
key_terms.شَرُّ بِقَاعِ الْأَرْضِ: the worst places on earth, referring here to markets because of temptation and wrongdoing
key_terms.مَيْدَانُ إِبْلِيسَ: the arena of Iblis, meaning a place where satanic influence becomes active
key_terms.مُطَفِّفٍ: one who gives short measure or cheats in quantity
key_terms.مِيزَانٍ: a scale used in weighing goods

ai.seo_question: Why are markets described as the worst places and mosques as the best places in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith contrasts markets and mosques as the worst and best places on earth in terms of spiritual danger and nearness to Allah. It warns against dishonesty and satanic influence in trade, while praising attachment to the masjid and eagerness in attending it.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3751 - The Commander of the Faithful (as) said:

A Bedouin from the tribe of Banu 'Amir came to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and asked him about the worst and the best places on earth.
The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said: "The worst places on earth are the markets-they are the playgrounds of Iblis. He sets out in the morning with his banner, places his throne there, and sends out his offspring among them. There, you find someone who cheats in measuring, another who falsifies the scale, someone who steals in length, or someone who lies about merchandise. Iblis then says to them: 'Stick to a man whose father has died while your father is still alive.' And he remains there, being the first to enter and the last to leave."
Then Imam (as) said: "And the best places are the mosques. The most beloved among them to Allah (swt), the Mighty and Exalted, are those who enter first and leave last."
